job: Swims through every word in a GitHub account's repos, public and (with a token for the account) private, and flags document-control, blatant, organizational and systemic errors.
runs_on: Any modern browser (index.html). Optional command line: Node 20 or newer.
built_with: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5), 2026-10-07; browser interface and naming corrections prepared with Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-08; private-repo support added with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-09; OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-11; Flash Audit repairs by OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-14
implementation_status: The canonical and dated browser entries share the auditor (public repos always; private repos too when the token belongs to the audited account) and explicit repo-scoped naming corrections. Rules stay in browser storage or a private CLI file; tokens stay only in memory. Private snapshots can be audited locally. There is no automatic learning or background monitoring. Original sprite.json is unchanged.
desktop_art_built_with: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6), built-in imagegen and native renderer, 2026-10-11
